items.html:
Kyle Hodsoll is a right-arm medium-fast bowler who bats in the lower-middle order. He made his one-day debut in October 2007 and played his maiden first-class game a month later in the Intercontinental Cup. Hodsoll has been selected in Bermuda's squad for the Under-19 World Cup in 2008.
Cricinfo staff February 2008

stories.title: Trott promoted to Bermuda national squad
stories.subTitle: Squad of 23 announced for 2008 season
stories.summary: In June-July Bermuda will travel to Canada for three one-day games before playing the Intercontinental Cup with Canada and Scotland. In September they will head to Namibia for the same tournament.

stories.title: Bermuda U-19s have chance to impress scouts
stories.subTitle: Under-19 World Cup 2008
stories.summary: Bermuda's Under-19 players could have a chance to put themselves in the frame for pro contracts when they compete at the youth World Cup in Malaysia next month
